description: Defines classes and functions for managing deep sleep and wakeup settings in a power management system, including DeepSleepController and DeepSleepWakeupSettings.

classes.name: DeepSleepWakeupSettings
classes.description: Manages wakeup timeout and timezone settings for deep sleep.

classes.name: DeepSleepController
classes.description: Controls deep sleep operations, including activation, deactivation, and wakeup reason retrieval.

classes.name: DeepSleepController::INotification
classes.description: Interface for deep sleep event notifications.

methods.name: DeepSleepWakeupSettings::SetTimeout
methods.description: Sets the deep sleep timeout value.

methods.name: DeepSleepController::Create
methods.description: Factory method to create a DeepSleepController instance with optional implementation.

methods.name: DeepSleepController::Activate
methods.description: Activates deep sleep mode with specified timeout and standby mode.

methods.name: DeepSleepController::GetLastWakeupReason
methods.description: Retrieves the reason for the last wakeup.

methods.name: DeepSleepController::GetLastWakeupKeyCode
methods.description: Retrieves the key code associated with the last wakeup.
